purpose: One predeclared stronger L2 regularization follow-up on revealed October development data; not a new holdout
estimator: Same frozen 12-feature, 39-nominal-parameter multiclass logistic regression, uniform weights
change_policy: Only C changes. Same mature train/calibration/test indices, seed, scaler, labels, iterations, solver defaults, features and class weights. Baseline models reused, not refitted.
primary_direction_truth: Sign of raw future return, evaluated on ALL actually nonzero returns; original neutral predictions are NOT excluded. Conditional diagnostic, not the full-coverage three-state task.
direction_probability: p(up)/(p(down)+p(up)); 0.5 if both directional probabilities are zero; deterministic down at exactly 0.5. Random coin uses the existing parent uniform bank; probabilistic coin forecast is 0.5.
direction_control: Per-asset Laplace direction prior computed only from the identical mature training sample's raw-sign outcomes

bootstrap.family: 2 challengers x 2 controls (matching C=0.1 and train prior) x 2 primary proper losses x 8 assets = 64 paired comparisons; positive means control loss minus challenger loss

disclosure: C=0.01 was selected after inspecting revealed October calibration. New adaptive research attempt registered before fits. Local max-t family does not correct every previous research attempt. No promotion regardless of result.
